description: Source file defining the GatewayEndpointStore actor which manages discovery, configuration, and state of the gateway control endpoint in an OpenClaw application for macOS. It includes methods for subscribing to state changes, ensuring remote tunnels, resolving configurations, and handling environment overrides.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointState
classes.description: Enum representing the state of the gateway endpoint, including ready, connecting, and unavailable states with associated data.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStore
classes.description: Actor responsible for managing the gateway control endpoint; singleton with shared instance. Handles configuration, state transitions, subscriptions, and remote tunnel management.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates an async stream to observe state changes in the gateway endpoint.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads current mode and updates the endpoint state accordingly.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the connection mode (local, remote, unconfigured) and updates internal state.

methods.name: ensureRemoteControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures the remote control tunnel is established and returns its port.

methods.name: requireConfig
methods.description: Returns the current gateway connection configuration, throwing if unavailable.

methods.name: cancelRemoteEnsure
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing attempt to establish remote tunnels.

methods.name: kickRemoteEnsureIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates or updates the remote tunnel establishment process.

methods.name: ensureRemoteConfig
methods.description: Ensures the remote configuration is ready, establishing tunnels if necessary.

methods.name: requireRemoteMode
methods.description: Throws if the current mode is not remote.

methods.name: resolveDirectRemoteURL
methods.description: Returns the direct remote URL if configured for direct transport.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the state change streams.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the actor's internal state and notifies subscribers.

methods.name: maybeFallbackToTailnet
methods.description: Attempts to switch to tailnet fallback if conditions are met, e.g., local mode and certain host and environment conditions.
